front: Grab a creature with Athletics against its Fortitude DC. You can keep it held without a free hand.
back:
Athletics vs. Fortitude DC. No free hand needed if the target is already grabbed or restrained.
Crit Success: target restrained until end of your next turn unless you move or it Escapes.
Success: target grabbed until end of your next turn unless you move or it Escapes.
Failure: no grab; existing grabbed/restrained from your Grapple ends.
Crit Failure: if you held it, it breaks free and may grab you or make you fall prone.
